name: Quote, word by word
description: A short sentence lands one word at a time in a big serif quote. Use for a line worth reading on screen: a quote, a rule, a punchline (max ~14 words).

text.description: The sentence, exactly as said (max ~14 words).

highlight.description: Words from the text to show in the accent colour.

wordTimes.description: Optional: seconds from the clip start when each word lands (from the transcript), so words land on the spoken word.

wordStep.description: Seconds between words when wordTimes is not given. Default fits the line into ~2 s.

quoteMarks.description: Show the big opening quote mark.

layout.description: top = card above the head, speaker stays visible. full = covers the frame (speaker hidden).

theme.description: light = warm white card, dark = near-black card, accent = card in the accent colour.

tilt.description: Tilt in degrees. Default -1.5 for top, 0 for full.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds. Leave out to use the template's own length.

drift.description: Slow push-in over the clip (0 = perfectly still).

region.description: Optional box (frame px, 1080x1920) the content must stay inside; the engine passes the free space above the face.

example.text: Nobody reads your caption until the first second earns it
